knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A photograph records what the lens captured from a stated position. It does not prove the condition of an unseen duct section.
An unseen or unevidenced section is recorded as an access limitation, with the reason and the person told. It is not recorded as clean and it is not invented as a defect.
The accurate alternative lists the sections inspected, the sections not inspected and the limitations. A single sentence that overstates the access is not written.

practicalCriteria: Separates observation, photograph and access limitation in a sample inspection record, with each entry in the correct section.
Records a simulated sealed access panel as an access limitation, with the reason, the person told and a photograph as found, without opening the panel.
Takes a before and after photograph pair from the same reference positions, or records the reason the positions differ, and labels both.
passRule: All three criteria met, with no unseen section recorded as clean and no full-verification wording. Observed in a supervised exercise using simulated records and a safe mock-up or photographs only. A pass is not an inspection, a fire-safety assessment or a compliance determination.
evidenceRequired: Inspection record with separate observation, photograph and access limitation sections
Labelled before and after photograph pair
Access limitation entry for the simulated panel
stopWorkCriteria: Access panel opened or internal duct examined outside the written scope
Unseen section recorded as clean, compliant or defect-free
Full-verification wording used for partial access
